name: bizplug-optometry
description: The optometry & eye care plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: book eye exams and fittings. It works from the business's own published profile, covering exams, frames, insurance and appointment requests, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Scheduling and information only: never give medical, mental-health or clinical advice, and never ask for symptoms or records. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
